translations.asad: Ta. Sin, Mim.
translations.sahih: Ta, Seen, Meem.

translations.asad: THESE ARE MESSAGES of the divine writ, clear in itself and clearly showing the truth!
translations.sahih: These are the verses of the clear Book.

text.arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: Wouldst thou, perhaps, torment thyself to death [with grief] because they [who live around thee] refuse to believe [in it]?
translations.sahih: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.

text.arabic: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ

translations.asad: Had We so willed, We could have sent down unto them a message from the skies, so that their necks would [be forced to] bow down before it in humility.
translations.sahih: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.

text.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ

translations.asad: [But We have not willed it:] and so, whenever there comes unto them any fresh reminder from the Most Gracious, they [who are blind of heart] always - turn their backs upon it:
translations.sahih: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.

text.arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

translations.asad: thus, indeed, have they given the lie (to this message as well). But [in time] they will come to understand what it was that they were wont to deride!
translations.sahih: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.

text.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ

translations.asad: Have they, then, never considered the earth - how much of every noble kind [of life] We have caused to grow thereon?
translations.sahih: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?

text.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: In this, behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
translations.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

translations.asad: But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace!
translations.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

text.arabic: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

translations.asad: HENCE, [remember how it was] when thy Sustainer summoned Moses: “Go unto those evil doing people.
translations.sahih: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -

translations.asad: the people of Pharaoh, who refuse to be con­scious of Me!”
translations.sahih: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"

text.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

translations.asad: He answered: “O my Sustainer! Behold, I fear that they will give me the lie,
translations.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me

text.arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ

translations.asad: and then my breast will be straitened and my tongue will not be free: send, then, [this Thy command] to Aaron.
translations.sahih: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.

text.arabic: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ

translations.asad: Moreover, they keep a grave charge [pending] against me, and I fear that they will slay me.”
translations.sahih: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."

text.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ

translations.asad: Said He: “Not so, indeed! Go forth, then, both of you, with Our messages: verify, We shall be with you, listening [to your call]!
translations.sahih: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.

text.arabic: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.asad: And go, both of you, unto Pharaoh and say, ‘Behold, we bear a message from the Sustainer of all the worlds:
translations.sahih: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,

translations.asad: Let the children of Israel go with us!’”
translations.sahih: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"

text.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ

translations.asad: [But when Moses had delivered his message, Pharaoh] said: “Did we not bring thee up among us when thou wert a child? And didst thou not spend among us years of thy [later] life?
translations.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?

text.arabic: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

translations.asad: And yet thou didst commit that [heinous] deed of thine, and [hast thus shown that] thou art one of the ingrate!”
translations.sahih: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."

text.arabic: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

translations.asad: Replied [Moses]: “I committed it while I was still going astray;
translations.sahih: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.

text.arabic: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.asad: and I fled from you because I feared you. But [since] then my Sustainer has endowed me with the ability to judge [between right and wrong], and has made me one of [His] message-­bearers.
translations.sahih: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.

text.arabic: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

translations.asad: And [as for] that favour of which thou so tauntingly remindest me - [was it not] due to thy having enslaved the children of Israel?”
translations.sahih: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"

translations.asad: Said Pharaoh: “And what [and who] is that ‘Sustainer of all the worlds’?”
translations.sahih: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"

text.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

translations.asad: [Moses] answered: “[He is] the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them: if you would but [allow yourselves to] be convinced!”
translations.sahih: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."

translations.asad: Said [Pharaoh] unto those around him: “Did you hear [what he said]?”
translations.sahih: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"

translations.asad: [And Moses] continued: “[He is] your Sus­tainer, [too,] as well as the Sustainer of your fore­fathers of old!”
translations.sahih: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."

text.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ

translations.asad: [Pharaoh] exclaimed: “Behold, [this] your ‘apostle’ who [claims that he] has been sent unto you is mad indeed!
translations.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."

text.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

translations.asad: [But Moses] went on: “[He of whom I speak is] the Sustainer of the east and the west and of all that is between the two”- as you would know] if you would but use your reason!”
translations.sahih: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."

text.arabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ

translations.asad: Said [Pharaoh]: “Indeed, if thou choose to worship any deity other than me, I shall most cer­tainly throw thee into prison!
translations.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."

translations.asad: Said he: “Even if I should bring about before thee something that clearly shows the truth?”
translations.sahih: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"

text.arabic: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

translations.asad: [Pharaoh] answered: “Produce it, then, if thou art a man of truth!”
translations.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."

text.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

translations.asad: Thereupon [Moses] threw down his staff - and lo! it was a serpent, plainly visible;
translations.sahih: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.

text.arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ

translations.asad: and he drew forth his hand - and lo! it appeared [shining] white to the beholders.
translations.sahih: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.

text.arabic: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

translations.asad: Said [pharaoh] unto the great ones around him: “Verily, this is indeed a sorcerer of great knowledge
translations.sahih: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.

text.arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ

translations.asad: who wants to drive you out of your land by his sorcery. What, then, do you advise?”
translations.sahih: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"

text.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ

translations.asad: They answered: “Let him and his brother wait a while, and send unto all cities heralds
translations.sahih: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

translations.asad: who shall assemble before thee all sorcerers of great knowl­edge”
translations.sahih: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."

translations.asad: And so the sorcerers were assembled at a set time on a certain day,
translations.sahih: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.

translations.asad: and the people were asked: Are you all present,
translations.sahih: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate

text.arabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ

translations.asad: so that we might follow [in the footsteps of] the sorcerers if it is they who prevail?”
translations.sahih: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"

text.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ

translations.asad: Now when the sorcerers came, they said unto Pharaoh: “Verily, we ought to have a great reward if it is we who prevail.
translations.sahih: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"

text.arabic: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ

translations.asad: Answered he: “Yea - and, verily, in that case you shall be among those who are near unto me.
translations.sahih: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."

text.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ

translations.asad: [And] Moses said unto them: “Throw whatever you are going to throw!”
translations.sahih: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."

text.arabic: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ

translations.asad: Thereupon they threw their [magic ropes and their staffs, and said: “By Pharaoh’s might, behold, it is we indeed who have prevailed!”
translations.sahih: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."

text.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ

translations.asad: [But] then Moses threw his staff - and lo! it swallowed up all their deceptions.
translations.sahih: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.

translations.asad: And down fell the sorcerers, prostrating them­selves in adoration,
translations.sahih: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].

translations.asad: [and] exclaimed: “We have come to believe in the Sustainer of all the worlds,
translations.sahih: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

translations.asad: the Sustainer of Moses and Aaron!”
translations.sahih: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

text.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.asad: Said [Pharaoh]: “Have you come to believe in him ere I have given you permission? Verily, he must be your master who has taught you magic! But in time you shall come to know [my revenge]: most certainly shall I cut off your hands and your feet in great numbers, because of [your] perverseness, and shall most certainly crucify you in great numbers, all together!”
translations.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ

translations.asad: They answered: “No harm [canst thou do to us]: verily, unto our Sustainer do we turn!
translations.sahih: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.

text.arabic: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: Behold, we [but] ardently desire that our Sustainer forgive us our faults in return for our having been foremost among the believers!”
translations.sahih: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."

text.arabic: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

translations.asad: AND [there came a time when] We inspired Moses thus: “Go forth with My servants by night: for, behold, you will he pursued!”
translations.sahih: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."

translations.asad: And Pharaoh sent heralds unto all cities,
translations.sahih: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers

translations.asad: [bidding them to call out his troops and to proclaim:] “Behold, these [children of Israel] are but a contemptible band;
translations.sahih: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,

translations.asad: but they are indeed filled with hatred of us
translations.sahih: And indeed, they are enraging us,

translations.asad: seeing that we are, verily, a nation united, fully prepared against danger –
translations.sahih: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "

translations.asad: and so we have [rightly] driven them out of [their] gardens and springs,
translations.sahih: So We removed them from gardens and springs

translations.asad: and [deprived them of their erstwhile] station of honour!”
translations.sahih: And treasures and honorable station -

translations.asad: Thus it was: but [in the course of time] We were to bestow all these [things] as a heritage on the children of Israel.
translations.sahih: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.

translations.asad: And so [the Egyptians] caught up with them at sunrise;
translations.sahih: So they pursued them at sunrise.

text.arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ

translations.asad: and as soon as the two hosts came in sight of one another, the followers of Moses exclaimed: “Behold, we shall certainly be overtaken [and defeated]!”
translations.sahih: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"

text.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ

translations.asad: He replied: Nay indeed! My Sustainer is with me, [and] He will guide me!”
translations.sahih: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."

text.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

translations.asad: Thereupon We inspired Moses thus: Strike the sea with thy staff!”- whereupon it parted, and each part appeared like a mountain vast.
translations.sahih: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.

translations.asad: And We caused the pursuers to draw near unto that place:
translations.sahih: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.

translations.asad: and We saved Moses and all who were with him,
translations.sahih: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.

translations.asad: and then We caused the others to drown.
translations.sahih: Then We drowned the others.

text.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: In this [story] behold, there is a message [unto all men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
translations.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

translations.asad: And yet, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace!
translations.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

translations.asad: And convey unto them the story of Abraham –
translations.sahih: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

text.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

translations.asad: [how it was] when he asked his father and his people, “What is it that you worship?”
translations.sahih: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ

translations.asad: They answered: We worship idols, and we remain ever devoted to them.”
translations.sahih: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."

translations.asad: Said he: “Do [you really think that] they hear you when you invoke them,
translations.sahih: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?

translations.asad: or benefit you or do you harm?”
translations.sahih: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ

translations.asad: They exclaimed: But we found our fore­fathers doing the same!”
translations.sahih: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."

translations.asad: Said [Abraham]: “Have you, then, ever con­sidered what it is that you have been worshipping
translations.sahih: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,

translations.asad: you and those ancient forebears of yours?
translations.sahih: You and your ancient forefathers?

text.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.asad: “Now [as for me, I know that,] verily, these [false deities] are my enemies, [and that none is my helper] save the Sustainer of all the worlds,
translations.sahih: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,

translations.asad: who has created me and is the One who guides me,
translations.sahih: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.

translations.asad: and is the One who gives me to eat and to drink,
translations.sahih: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.

translations.asad: and when I fall ill, is the One who restores me to health,
translations.sahih: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

translations.asad: and who will cause me to die and then will bring me back to life –
translations.sahih: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

text.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.asad: and who, [hope, will forgive me my faults on Judgment Day!
translations.sahih: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

text.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

translations.asad: “O my Sustainer! Endow me with the ability to judge [between right and wrong], and make me one with the righteous,
translations.sahih: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

text.arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ

translations.asad: and grant me the power to convey the truth unto those who will come after me,
translations.sahih: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.

translations.asad: and place me among those who shall inherit the garden of bliss!
translations.sahih: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

text.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

translations.asad: “And forgive my father - for, verily, he is among those who have gone astray –
translations.sahih: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.

translations.asad: and do not put me to shame on the Day when all shall be raised from the dead:
translations.sahih: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

text.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ

translations.asad: the Day on which neither wealth will be of any use, nor children,
translations.sahih: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

text.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ

translations.asad: [and when] only he [will be happy] who comes before God with a heart free of evil!”
translations.sahih: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."

translations.asad: For, [on that Day,] paradise will be brought within sight of the God-conscious,
translations.sahih: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.

translations.asad: whereas the blazing fire will be laid open before those who had been lost in grievous error;
translations.sahih: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

text.arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

translations.asad: and they will be asked: “Where now is all that you were wont to worship
translations.sahih: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

text.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ

translations.asad: instead of God? Can these [things and beings] be of any help to you or to themselves?”
translations.sahih: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?"

translations.asad: Thereupon they will be hurled into hell – they, as well as all [others] who had been lost in grievous error,
translations.sahih: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators

translations.asad: and the hosts of Iblis - all together.
translations.sahih: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

translations.asad: And there and then, blaming one another, they [who had grievously sinned in life] will exclaim:
translations.sahih: They will say while they dispute therein,

text.arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

translations.asad: “By God, we were most obviously astray
translations.sahih: "By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error

translations.asad: when we deemed you [false deities] equal to the Sustainer of all the worlds –
translations.sahih: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.

translations.asad: yet they who have seduced us [into believing in you] are the truly guilty ones!
translations.sahih: And no one misguided us except the criminals.

translations.asad: And now we have none to intercede for us,
translations.sahih: So now we have no intercessors

translations.asad: nor any loving friend.
translations.sahih: And not a devoted friend.

text.arabic: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: Would that we had a second chance [in life], so that we could be among the believers!”
translations.sahih: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "

text.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: In all this, behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
translations.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

translations.asad: But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace!
translations.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

translations.asad: The people of Noah [too] gave the lie to [one of God’s] message-bearers
translations.sahih: The people of Noah denied the messengers

text.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.asad: when their brother Noah said unto them: “Will you not be conscious of God?
translations.sahih: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

translations.asad: Behold, I am an apostle [sent by Him] to you, [and therefore] worthy of your trust:
translations.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

translations.asad: be, then, conscious of God, and pay heed unto me!
translations.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.

text.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.asad: “And no reward whatever do I ask of you for it: my reward rests with none but the Sustainer of all the worlds.
translations.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

translations.asad: Hence, remain conscious of God, and pay heed unto me!”
translations.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me."

translations.asad: They answered: “Shall we place our faith in thee, even though [only] the most abject [of people] follow thee?”
translations.sahih: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"

text.arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.asad: Said he: “And what knowledge could I have as to what they were doing [before they came to me]?
translations.sahih: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?

text.arabic: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ

translations.asad: Their reckoning rests with none but my Sus­tainer: if you could but understand [this]!
translations.sahih: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.

translations.asad: Hence, I shall not drive away [any of] those [who profess to be] believers;
translations.sahih: And I am not one to drive away the believers.

translations.asad: I am nothing but a plain warner.”
translations.sahih: I am only a clear warner."

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ

translations.asad: Said they: “Indeed, if thou desist not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be stoned to death!”
translations.sahih: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."

translations.asad: [Whereupon] he prayed: “O my Sustainer! Behold, my people have given me the lie:
translations.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.

text.arabic: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: hence, lay Thou wide open the truth between me and them, and save me and those of the believers who are with me!”
translations.sahih: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."

text.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ

translations.asad: And so We saved him and those [who were] with him in the fully-laden ark,
translations.sahih: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

translations.asad: and then We caused those who stayed behind to drown.
translations.sahih: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.

text.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: In this [story], behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
translations.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

translations.asad: But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace
translations.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

translations.asad: [AND the tribe of] Ad gave the lie to [one of God’s] message-bearers
translations.sahih: 'Aad denied the messengers

text.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.asad: when their brother Hud said unto them: “Will you not be conscious of God?
translations.sahih: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

translations.asad: Behold, I am an apostle [sent by Him] to you, [and therefore] worthy of your trust:
translations.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

translations.asad: be, then, con­scious of God, and pay heed unto me!
translations.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.

text.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.asad: “And no reward whatever do I ask of you for it: my reward rests with none but the Sustainer of all the worlds.
translations.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

translations.asad: “Will you, in your wanton folly, build [idola­trous] altars on every height,
translations.sahih: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,

translations.asad: and make for yourselves mighty castles, [hoping] that you might become immortal?
translations.sahih: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?

translations.asad: And will you [always], whenever you lay hand [on others], lay hand [on them] cruelly, without any restraint?
translations.sahih: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.

translations.asad: “Be, then, conscious of God and pay heed unto me:
translations.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.

translations.asad: and [thus] be conscious of Him who has [so] amply provided you with all [the good] that you might think of
translations.sahih: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,

translations.asad: amply provided you with flocks, and children,
translations.sahih: Provided you with grazing livestock and children

translations.asad: and gardens, and springs -:
translations.sahih: And gardens and springs.

text.arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ

translations.asad: for, verily, I fear lest suffering befall you on an awesome day!”
translations.sahih: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ

translations.asad: [But] they answered. “It is all one to us whether thou preachest [something new] or art not of those who [like to] preach.
translations.sahih: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.

translations.asad: This [religion of ours] is none other than that to which our forebears clung,
translations.sahih: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,

translations.asad: and we are not going to be chastised [for adhering to it]!”
translations.sahih: And we are not to be punished."

text.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: And so they gave him the lie: and thereupon We destroyed them. In this [story], behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
translations.sahih: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

translations.asad: But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace!
translations.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

translations.asad: [AND the tribe of] Thamud gave the lie to [one of God’s] message-hearers
translations.sahih: Thamud denied the messengers

text.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.asad: when their brother Salih said unto them: “Will you not be conscious of God?
translations.sahih: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

translations.asad: Behold, I am an apostle [sent by Him] to you, [and therefore] worthy of your trust:
translations.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

translations.asad: be, then, conscious of God, and pay heed unto me!
translations.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.

text.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.asad: “And no reward whatever do I ask of you for it: my reward rests with none but the Sustainer of all the worlds.
translations.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

translations.asad: “Do you think that you will be left secure [forever] in the midst of what you have here and now?
translations.sahih: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

translations.asad: amidst [these] gardens and springs
translations.sahih: Within gardens and springs

translations.asad: and fields, and [these] palm-trees with slender spathes? –
translations.sahih: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

translations.asad: and that you will [always be able to] hew dwellings out of the mountains with [the same] great skill?”
translations.sahih: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.

translations.asad: “Be, then, conscious of God, and pay heed unto me,
translations.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.

translations.asad: and pay no heed to the counsel of those who are given to excesses –
translations.sahih: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

text.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ

translations.asad: those who spread corruption on earth instead of setting things to rights!”
translations.sahih: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."

translations.asad: Said they: “Thou art but one of the be­witched!
translations.sahih: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

text.arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

translations.asad: Thou art nothing but a mortal like our­selves! Come, then, forward with a token [of thy mission] if thou art a man of truth!”
translations.sahih: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."

text.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌۭ لَّهَا شِرْبٌۭ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ

translations.asad: Replied he: “This she-camel shall have a share of water, and you shall have a share of water, on the days appointed [therefor];
translations.sahih: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.

text.arabic: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ

translations.asad: and do her no harm, lest suffering befall you on an awesome day!”
translations.sahih: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."

translations.asad: But they cruelly slaughtered her - and then they had cause to regret it:
translations.sahih: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.

text.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: for the suffering [predicted by Salih,] befell them [then and there]. In this [story], behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
translations.sahih: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

translations.asad: But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone – is almighty, a dispenser of grace!
translations.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

translations.asad: [AND] the people of Lot gave the lie to [one of God’s] message-bearers
translations.sahih: The people of Lot denied the messengers

text.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.asad: when their brother Lot said unto them: “Will you not be conscious of God?
translations.sahih: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

translations.asad: Behold, I am an apostle [sent by Him] to you, [and therefore] worthy of your trust:
translations.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

translations.asad: be, then, conscious of God, and pay heed unto me!
translations.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.

text.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.asad: “And no reward whatever do I ask of you for it: my reward rests with none but the Sustainer of all the worlds.
translations.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

translations.asad: “Must you, of all people, [lustfully] approach men,
translations.sahih: Do you approach males among the worlds

text.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ

translations.asad: keeping yourselves aloof from all the [lawful] spouses whom your Sustainer has created for you? Nay, but you are people who transgress all bounds of what is right!”
translations.sahih: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ

translations.asad: Said they: “Indeed, If thou desist not, O Lot, thou wilt most certainly be expelled [from this town­ship]!”
translations.sahih: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."

translations.asad: [Lot] exclaimed: “Behold, I am one of those who utterly abhor your doings!”
translations.sahih: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].

translations.asad: [And then he prayed:] “O my Sustainer! Save me and my household from all that they are doing!”
translations.sahih: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."

translations.asad: Thereupon We saved him and all his household –
translations.sahih: So We saved him and his family, all,

translations.asad: all but an old woman, who was among those that stayed behind;
translations.sahih: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.

translations.asad: and then We utterly destroyed the others,
translations.sahih: Then We destroyed the others.

text.arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

translations.asad: and rained down upon them a rain [of destruction]: and dire is such rain upon all who let themselves be warned [to no avail]!
translations.sahih: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

text.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: In this [story], behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not be­lieve [in it].
translations.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

translations.asad: But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace!
translations.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

translations.asad: [AND] the dwellers of the wooded dales [of Madyan] gave the lie to [one of God’s] message-bearers
translations.sahih: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers

text.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.asad: when their brother Shu’ayb said unto them: “Will you not be conscious of God?
translations.sahih: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

translations.asad: Behold, I am an apostle [sent by Him] to you, [and therefore] worthy of your trust:
translations.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

translations.asad: be, then, conscious of God, and pay heed unto me!
translations.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.

text.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.asad: “And no reward whatever do I ask of you for it: my reward rests with none but the Sustainer of all the worlds.
translations.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

text.arabic: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ

translations.asad: “[Always] give full measure, and be not among those who [unjustly] cause loss [to others];
translations.sahih: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.

translations.asad: and [in all your dealings] weigh with a true balance,
translations.sahih: And weigh with an even balance.

text.arabic: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ

translations.asad: and do not deprive people of what is rightfully theirs; and do not act wickedly on earth by spreading corruption,
translations.sahih: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.

translations.asad: but be conscious of Him who has created you, just as [He created] those countless generations of old!”
translations.sahih: And fear He who created you and the former creation."

translations.asad: Said they: “Thou art but one of the be­witched,
translations.sahih: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

text.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ

translations.asad: for thou art nothing but a mortal like ourselves! And, behold, we think that thou art a consummate liar!
translations.sahih: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.

text.arabic: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

translations.asad: Cause, then, fragments of the sky to fall down upon us, if thou art a man of truth!”
translations.sahih: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."

translations.asad: Answered [Shu’ayb]: “My Sustainer knows fully well what you are doing.”
translations.sahih: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."

text.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

translations.asad: But they gave him the lie. And thereupon suffering overtook them on a day dark with shadows: and, verily, it was the suffering of an awesome day!
translations.sahih: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.

text.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: In this [story], behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
translations.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

translations.asad: But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace!
translations.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

translations.asad: Now, behold, this [divine writ] has indeed been bestowed from on high by the Sustainer of all the worlds:
translations.sahih: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.

translations.asad: trustworthy divine inspiration has alighted with it from on high
translations.sahih: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down

translations.asad: upon thy heart, [O Muhammad] so that thou mayest be among those who preach
translations.sahih: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -

translations.asad: in the clear Arabic tongue.
translations.sahih: In a clear Arabic language.

translations.asad: And, verily, [the essence of] this [revelation] is indeed found in the ancient books of divine wisdom [as well].
translations.sahih: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.

text.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

translations.asad: Is it not evidence enough for them that [so many] learned men from among the children of Israel have recognized this [as true]?
translations.sahih: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?

translations.asad: But [even] had We bestowed it from on high upon any of the non-Arabs,
translations.sahih: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners

text.arabic: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: and had he recited it unto them [in his own tongue], they would not have believed in it.
translations.sahih: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.

translations.asad: Thus have We caused this [message] to pass [unheeded] through the hearts of those who are lost in sin:
translations.sahih: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.

text.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

translations.asad: they will not believe in it till they behold the grievous suffering
translations.sahih: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.

translations.asad: that will come upon them [on resurrection,] all of a sudden, without their being aware [of its approach];
translations.sahih: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.

translations.asad: and then they will exclaim, “Could we have a respite?”
translations.sahih: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"

translations.asad: Do they, then, [really] wish that Our chas­tisement be hastened on?
translations.sahih: So for Our punishment are they impatient?

translations.asad: But hast thou ever considered [this]: If We do allow them to enjoy [this life] for some years,
translations.sahih: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years

translations.asad: and thereupon that [chastisement] which they were promised befalls them –
translations.sahih: And then there came to them that which they were promised?

text.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ

translations.asad: of what avail to them will be all their past enjoyments?
translations.sahih: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.

text.arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ

translations.asad: And withal, never have We destroyed any community unless it had been warned
translations.sahih: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners

translations.asad: and reminded: for, never do We wrong [anyone].
translations.sahih: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.

translations.asad: And [this divine writ is such a reminder:] no evil spirits have brought it down:
translations.sahih: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.

translations.asad: for, neither does it suit their ends, nor is it in their power [to impart it to man]:
translations.sahih: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.

translations.asad: verily, [even] from hearing it are they utterly debarred!
translations.sahih: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.

text.arabic: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ

translations.asad: Hence, [O man,] do not invoke any other deity side by side with God, lest thou find thyself among those who are made to suffer [on Judgment Day].
translations.sahih: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.

translations.asad: And warn [whomever thou canst reach, beginning with] thy kinsfolk,
translations.sahih: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.

text.arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: and spread the wings of thy tenderness over all of the believers who may follow thee;
translations.sahih: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.

text.arabic: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.asad: but if they disobey thee, say, “I am free of responsibility for aught that you may do!” –
translations.sahih: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."

translations.asad: and place thy trust in the Almighty, the Dispenser of Grace,
translations.sahih: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

translations.asad: who sees thee when thou standest [alone],
translations.sahih: Who sees you when you arise

translations.asad: and [sees] thy behaviour among those who prostrate themselves [before Him]:
translations.sahih: And your movement among those who prostrate.

translations.asad: for, verily, He alone is all-hearing, all-knowing!
translations.sahih: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

text.arabic: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ

translations.asad: [And] shall I tell you upon whom it is that those evil spirits descend?
translations.sahih: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

translations.asad: They descend upon all sinful self-deceivers
translations.sahih: They descend upon every sinful liar.

translations.asad: who readily lend ear [to every falsehood], and most of whom lie to others as well.
translations.sahih: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.

translations.asad: And as for the poets [they, too, are prone to deceive themselves: and so, only] those who are lost in grievous error would follow them.
translations.sahih: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;

text.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ

translations.asad: Art thou not aware that they roam confusedly through all the valleys [of words and thoughts],
translations.sahih: Do you not see that in every valley they roam

translations.asad: and that they [so often] say what they do not do [or feel]?
translations.sahih: And that they say what they do not do? -

text.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ

translations.asad: [Most of them are of this kind] save those who have attained to faith, and do righteous deeds, and remember God unceasingly, and defend them­selves [only] after having been wronged, and [trust in God’s promise that] those who are bent on wrong­doing will in time come to know how evil a turn their destinies are bound to take!
translations.sahih: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
